Set your levels, pick what to scan, then press Scan prices. Levels 50–80 take about a minute.

Batch

Batch

Add crafts from the results, or fill the batch automatically within a budget.

Sell price is the lower of the recent average sale and the cheapest current listing on your world, so it assumes you match the market. Material cost uses the cheapest listing across your data center, or crafting or gathering it when those options are on and cheaper. Daily potential is profit × sales per day: the size of the opportunity, not a promise. Universalis data is crowdsourced, so check yellow (stale) prices in game before buying.
